content.text: The profiling found an \(O(n^2)\) split implementation: removing a small intersection scanned the entire remaining block. I’m replacing block lists with destructively split sets and updating only the extracted part, reducing split work to the intersection size.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='/workspace/submission/main.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('accepting_block = [state for state in range(n) if accepting[state]]\n    rejecting_block = [state for state in range(n) if not accepting[state]]', 'accepting_block = {state for state in range(n) if accepting[state]}\n    rejecting_block = {state for state in range(n) if not accepting[state]}')
old='''                inside = set(intersection)
                difference = [state for state in block if state not in inside]
                new_id = next_block
                next_block += 1
                blocks[block_id] = intersection
                blocks[new_id] = difference
                for state in difference:
                    state_block[state] = new_id

                if block_id in work:
                    work.add(new_id)
                elif len(intersection) <= len(difference):
                    work.add(block_id)
                else:
                    work.add(new_id)
'''
new='''                inside = set(intersection)
                # If this is the active splitter, preserve its original value
                # for the remaining alphabet symbols before mutating the set.
                if block is splitter:
                    splitter = block.copy()
                block.difference_update(inside)
                new_id = next_block
                next_block += 1
                # The old block id denotes the difference, so only states in
                # the extracted intersection need their labels changed.
                blocks[new_id] = inside
                for state in inside:
                    state_block[state] = new_id

                if block_id in work:
                    work.add(new_id)
                elif len(inside) <= len(block):
                    work.add(block_id)
                else:
                    work.add(new_id)
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('representative = blocks[block_id][0]', 'representative = next(iter(blocks[block_id]))')
s=s.replace('minimal_accepting = [accepting[blocks[block_id][0]] for block_id in order]', 'minimal_accepting = [accepting[next(iter(blocks[block_id]))] for block_id in order]')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cd /workspace && python3 public_check.py && python3 /workspace/tmp/test_random.py && for args in 'chain 20000 2' 'chain 20000 24' 'random 20000 24' 'cycles 20000 24'; do echo ---$args; python3 /workspace/tmp/bench.py $args; done
